name: Preethi Sundaram-Kowalski
description: Preethi Sundaram-Kowalski is the defining figure of the Purist athletic movement, a Tamil-Polish long-distance runner who has won the Lakeshore Open six times between 2191 and 2201 without a single registered augmentation or verified geneware modification — a claim independently audited by three competing corponation labs. She trains on a publicly documented regimen of altitude simulation, neural-unassisted pain management, and a diet she formulates herself from licensed synth-protein compounds, and she publishes every data point free-to-access on open pirate channels as a deliberate rebuke to corporate performance science. Her 2196 Lakeshore record still stands.
story_hooks: A young the Gray Zone runner is training under Sundaram-Kowalski's open-source program when they discover her published data has been subtly altered by an unknown party — someone is either trying to protect her or discredit her.
A Tier 4 corponation executive offers Sundaram-Kowalski a contract so generous it would fund a the Gray Zone youth clinic for twenty years; accepting would end her independence and her meaning.
After her eighth Lakeshore attempt ends in a suspicious on-course medical collapse, the attending medics' BCI logs go missing before an independent review can be conducted.
